description: This file implements a client for handling push notification registration with a relay server, including fetching challenges, creating attestations with Apple App Attest, managing receipts, and sending registration requests.

classes.name: PushRelayReceiptRefreshCoordinator
classes.description: Handles receipt refresh requests using SKReceiptRefreshRequest and manages asynchronous flow.

classes.name: PushRelayAppAttestService
classes.description: Provides methods to create proof using Apple App Attest, including key management and attestation issuance.

classes.name: PushRelayReceiptProvider
classes.description: Loads and refreshes the App Store receipt, providing it as a Base64 string.

classes.name: PushRelayClient
classes.description: Main client class for registering push tokens with relay server, handling challenges, and attestation workflow.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the device for push notifications by fetching a challenge, creating attestations, and posting registration data to server.

methods.name: fetchChallenge
methods.description: Fetches a push challenge from the relay server.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes JSON data into specified type.
